rule: Candidates are seeds, not pages. On a site that runs the shared search loop (owner ruling 1 Nov 2026) they feed its FIND stage and a page publishes once it passes the engine's gate. Their other use is the FAQ/H2 questions on the seed's existing page (questions_for_page), which the strengthening passes read.
seed_rule: queries with >= 2 impressions in the report's 28-day window, top 40 by impressions
